observed_bottleneck: Parent n-a1feb7fbd3ae retains a five-epoch hard-target token-likelihood prior and reaches a three-seed macro mean of 0.4999210858091477, with its weakest task means still only 0.21139955631803173 on median_2 and 0.2611605684579006 on sitagliptin_mpo. The exact Parent-prior probe in n-1e6816bbc389 shows strong pooled held-out NLL of 0.677628237451252 and 768/768 ancestral completion, but only 656/768 completed draws are valid unique canonical molecules; because valid-canonical and unique-valid counts are identical, all 112 unusable completions are invalid rather than duplicate graphs. That node also shows no checkpoint-selection opportunity: the terminal state has the best audited valid-unique support on every preparation seed. Evidence from the same clean GRU-prior family in n-20155ff85181 sharpens the diagnosis: three more hard-target epochs lower training NLL by 0.024093488852183025 yet reduce preparation valid-unique support from 645/768 to 609/768 and change macro score by -0.00274054926385936. The limiting behavior addressed here is therefore confidence concentration under an exclusively hard-target objective with no pressure to retain plausible alternative next tokens, not premature stopping, selection of the wrong existing checkpoint, graph replay, beam triggering, or motif gating.
hypothesis: Add one bounded task-agnostic confidence-penalty calibration pass after the Parent's unchanged five corpus-pretraining epochs, updating only the output projection on clean teacher-forced prefixes so overconfident next-token distributions retain more contextually available lexical support without changing the recurrent representation or downstream policy interface.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, freeze a copy as the prior, and restart a trainable agent for each independent objective session. Generate the first proposals ancestrally, then use returned oracle scores to apply top-fraction prior-regularized likelihood updates to the agent. Whenever the recent reward trajectory shows sustained improvement, run Beam Enumeration on the current agent without calling the oracle: expand its most probable partial token trajectories, convert chemically interpretable partial strings into connected molecular substructures, and retain a small task-local pool of recurrent motifs. Fill subsequent evaluator-announced batches by sampling complete SMILES de novo from the agent and locally rejecting any valid novel sample that lacks every pooled motif; canonicalize and remove already evaluated or within-batch duplicates before submission. The enumerated objects are transient partial token trajectories, not whole candidate molecules, and neither they nor any corpus molecule are scored, ranked, retrieved, or submitted as a finite library. Thus oracle feedback changes both the policy and a dynamic structural gate on fresh generation, concentrating the 290 adaptive calls on chemistry expressed by successful policy updates while the only success criterion remains the mean of the five independent final Top-1 scores.

method_tags.acquisition_mechanism: membership in a task-local beam-derived motif pool before oracle submission, with no scoring of the transient internal samples

method_tags.proposal_mechanism: dynamic top-probability beam expansion for motif extraction followed by motif-gated rejection sampling of complete de novo SMILES
method_tags.representation: tokenized SMILES plus RDKit-extracted connected substructures from partial token trajectories
